One who eats food that is wholesome, in moderate quantities, and appropriate for the season, time, and place. (Wise saying) Medu and Mishti read ‘thought of the day’ on the school noticeboard every day. Today’s thought, ‘annena jātāni jivanti’, makes them curious. Mishti tells Medu that it is a Sanskrit saying which means ‘food gives life to living beings.’ Let us try to understand the significance of this saying.
